scope: Primary-source concept review, bounded section reads, not exhaustive literature or a measured optimization result. No paper performance figure is treated as this project's result.

sources.title: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
sources.read_scope: Sections3.1/3.2, selected4.1 and5.5.4; not the whole paper.
sources.transfer_lesson: Parallel draft cost and accepted-token yield must be optimized jointly; inference-width studies are not proof for this fixed released drafter.

sources.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
sources.read_scope: Introduction and cost theorem3.8/assumptions; not the entire PDF.
sources.transfer_lesson: Distribution preservation requires the verification algorithm; theoretical speedups assume cost/acceptance conditions.

sources.title: Sequoia: Scalable, Robust, and Hardware-aware Speculative Decoding
sources.read_scope: Section3.3 cost-aware tree optimizer and selected background; no tree implementation audit.
sources.transfer_lesson: Measure verifier cost as a function of actual hardware/workload; do not optimize acceptance alone or import a replacement drafter.

sources.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
sources.read_scope: Section3 radix caching/eviction and selected appendix cache-aware scheduling; not full27pages.
sources.transfer_lesson: Prefix reuse and cache-aware scheduling can reduce repeated prefill; shared nodes need reference-count/lifetime correctness.

sources.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
sources.read_scope: Sections4.1/4.2/4.5, abstract; no full implementation audit.
sources.transfer_lesson: Memory allocation/sharing can determine feasible batching; page size trades locality against fragmentation.

sources.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
sources.read_scope: Sections3.1/3.2, register-pressure discussion and selected appendix; not full paper.
sources.transfer_lesson: Asynchronous producer/consumer work trades register/shared-memory resources against overlap. Low-precision results are not automatically admissible.

sources.title: CUDA Programmatic Dependent Launch and Synchronization
sources.read_scope: Section4.5 semantics, visibility/synchronization, opportunistic concurrency and graph use.
sources.transfer_lesson: Overlap independent work, enforce producer readiness, and never depend on concurrent block residency for progress.

sources.title: Using NCCL with CUDA Graphs
sources.version: Documentation2.32.3, not proof of deployed version
sources.transfer_lesson: Capture decisions and graph launches must be uniform over participating ranks; graph support does not remove collective ordering requirements.

sources.title: HiCache System Design and Optimization
sources.read_scope: Local pinned document: hierarchy, tier scope, writeback/prefetch policies, overlap and multi-rank synchronization.
sources.transfer_lesson: The fixed workload already enables host cache; optimize observed transfer/recompute stalls rather than enabling it again.

sources.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
sources.read_scope: Abstract and selected design/chunked-prefill passages; no source port.
sources.transfer_lesson: Scheduling must balance prefill and ongoing decode latency; throughput without interactivity compliance is insufficient.

sources.title: DeepEP
sources.read_scope: README introduction, requirements, BF16 input and wait/overlap sections; no device-code audit.
sources.transfer_lesson: Communication/compute overlap requires explicit readiness and valid expanded-row ownership; protocol/version changes are not drop-in fixes.

sources.title: humming-kernels0.1.12
sources.version: Exact package SHA recorded in prior reports
sources.read_scope: Prior pinned API/MMA/epilogue/tuning source audit; unchanged source files stored in repo.
sources.transfer_lesson: FP32 MMA does not imply FP32 inter-block partial reduction; keep the explicit no-Stream-K prototype guard.
